studies.title: Experimental evidence on the productivity effects of generative artificial intelligence
studies.reported_finding: Controlled professional writing tasks reported approximately 40% less completion time and 18% higher assessed quality.
studies.caution: Short professional-writing tasks; neither industrial production nor long-run enterprise cash savings. Confirm full text before using the figures in a public pitch.
studies.model_use: Supports testing report drafting separately from repair and document search.
studies.verification: Bibliographic knowledge; full text not retrieved in this task.

studies.title: Navigating the Jagged Technological Frontier: Field Experimental Evidence of the Effects of AI on Knowledge Worker Productivity and Quality
studies.type: Harvard Business School working paper 24-013; BCG field experiment
studies.reported_finding: The experiment with 758 consultants reported 25.1% faster work, 12.2% more completed tasks and higher quality on tasks inside the technology frontier. On a task outside the frontier, AI users were 19 percentage points less likely to produce a correct solution.
studies.caution: Knowledge tasks and one experimental setting. The negative result is a reason to measure answer usability, retain human review and include error response costs.
studies.model_use: Usable-answer fraction, human verification cost and pilot stop criteria; not a plant uplift benchmark.
studies.verification: Bibliographic knowledge; source page not retrieved in this task.
